anr.rule_weight > 0 OR anr.rule_id LIKE 'EFRuP@%' ) GROUP BY anr.alert_id, anr.tenant_id, anr.typology_id, anr.typology_cfg ) SELECT anh.alert_id, anh.tenant_id, anh.case_id, anh.tx_msg_id, anh.transaction_amount, anh.transaction_currency, anh.transaction_id, anh.alert_date, COLLECT_LIST( NAMED_STRUCT( 'typology_id', ant.typology_id, 'typology_cfg', ant.typology_cfg, 'typology_score', typologies FROM alert_navigator_header anh LEFT JOIN alert_navigator_typologies ant ON ant.alert_id = anh.alert_id AND ant.tenant_id = anh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN rules_agg ra ON ra.alert_id = ant.alert_id AND ra.tenant_id = ant.tenant_id AND ra.typology_id = ant.typology_id AND ra.typology_cfg = ant.typology_cfg WHERE anh.alert_id = 796 AND anh.tenant_id = 'DEFAULT' GROUP BY anh.alert_id, anh.alert_status, anh.transaction_status, anh.transaction_amount, anh.transaction_currency, anh.transaction_id, anh.alert_date

SELECT DISTINCT debtor_name AS holder_name FROM transaction_detail td JOIN counterparty_account_links cal ON td.debtor_account_id = cal.account_id WHERE td.tenant_id = 'DEFAULT' AND cal.counterparty_id = '3582911bbef34a028468a40bccea5995TAZAMA_EID' LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN td.debtor_id = 'a7c5e754bb254bb6a2357c5ff04442c8TAZAMA_EID' THEN td.debtor_id ELSE td.creditor_id END AS entity_id, CASE WHEN td.debtor_id = 'a7c5e754bb254bb6a2357c5ff04442c8TAZAMA_EID' THEN td.debtor_name ELSE td.creditor_name END AS entity_name, CASE WHEN td.debtor_id = 'a7c5e754bb254bb6a2357c5ff04442c8TAZAMA_EID' THEN 'DEBTOR' ELSE 'CREDITOR' END AS entity_role, COUNT(DISTINCT a.alert_id) AS total_alerts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) FILTER (WHERE c.case_id IS NOT NULL) AS cases_opened, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.status LIKE 'STATUS_%' AND c.status != 'STATUS_00_DRAFT' THEN c.case_id END) AS investigations, COALESCE(SUM(t.sar_filings), 0) AS sar_filings, COALESCE(SUM(td.instructed_amount), 0) AS total_value FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN transaction_detail td ON a.tx_original_e2e_id = td.end_to_end_id AND td.tx_type = 'pacs.008.001.10' LEFT JOIN cases c ON a.case_id = c.case_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT case_id, COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER (WHERE task_type LIKE '%SAR_STR_FILING%') AS sar_filings FROM tasks GROUP BY case_id ) t ON c.case_id = t.case_id WHERE a.tenant_id = 'DEFAULT' AND a.created_at_ts >= '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AND (td.debtor_id = 'a7c5e754bb254bb6a2357c5ff04442c8TAZAMA_EID' OR td.creditor_id = 'a7c5e754bb254bb6a2357c5ff04442c8TAZAMA_EID') GROUP BY entity_id, entity_name, entity_role

SELECT DISTINCT a.alert_id, a.created_at_ts as date, a.alert_type_norm as type, a.priority_norm as severity, a.alert_status as status, a.case_id, c.status as case_status, a.evaluation_id FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN transaction_detail td ON a.tx_original_e2e_id = td.end_to_end_id AND td.tx_type = 'pacs.008.001.10' LEFT JOIN cases c ON a.case_id = c.case_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.tenant_id = 'DEFAULT' AND a.created_at_ts >= '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AND (td.debtor_id = 'a7c5e754bb254bb6a2357c5ff04442c8TAZAMA_EID' OR td.creditor_id = 'a7c5e754bb254bb6a2357c5ff04442c8TAZAMA_EID') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1000 OFFSET 0

SELECT CASE WHEN td.debtor_id = '3582911bbef34a028468a40bccea5995TAZAMA_EID' THEN td.debtor_id ELSE td.creditor_id END AS entity_id, CASE WHEN td.debtor_id = '3582911bbef34a028468a40bccea5995TAZAMA_EID' THEN td.debtor_name ELSE td.creditor_name END AS entity_name, CASE WHEN td.debtor_id = '3582911bbef34a028468a40bccea5995TAZAMA_EID' THEN 'DEBTOR' ELSE 'CREDITOR' END AS entity_role, COUNT(DISTINCT a.alert_id) AS total_alerts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) FILTER (WHERE c.case_id IS NOT NULL) AS cases_opened, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.status LIKE 'STATUS_%' AND c.status != 'STATUS_00_DRAFT' THEN c.case_id END) AS investigations, COALESCE(SUM(t.sar_filings), 0) AS sar_filings, COALESCE(SUM(td.instructed_amount), 0) AS total_value FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN transaction_detail td ON a.tx_original_e2e_id = td.end_to_end_id AND td.tx_type = 'pacs.008.001.10' LEFT JOIN cases c ON a.case_id = c.case_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT case_id, COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER (WHERE task_type LIKE '%SAR_STR_FILING%') AS sar_filings FROM tasks GROUP BY case_id ) t ON c.case_id = t.case_id WHERE a.tenant_id = 'DEFAULT' AND a.created_at_ts >= '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AND (td.debtor_id = '3582911bbef34a028468a40bccea5995TAZAMA_EID' OR td.creditor_id = '3582911bbef34a028468a40bccea5995TAZAMA_EID') GROUP BY entity_id, entity_name, entity_role

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', a.created_at_ts) as date, COUNT(DISTINCT a.alert_id) as alert_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) FILTER (WHERE c.case_id IS NOT NULL) as case_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.status LIKE 'STATUS_%' AND c.status != 'STATUS_00_DRAFT' THEN c.case_id END) as investigation_count, COALESCE(SUM(td.instructed_amount), 0) as total_value FROM alerts a LEFT JOIN transaction_detail td ON a.tx_original_e2e_id = td.end_to_end_id AND td.tx_type = 'pacs.008.001.10' LEFT JOIN cases c ON a.case_id = c.case_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.tenant_id = 'DEFAULT' AND a.created_at_ts >= '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AND (td.debtor_id = '3582911bbef34a028468a40bccea5995TAZAMA_EID' OR td.creditor_id = '3582911bbef34a028468a40bccea5995TAZAMA_EID') GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', a.created_at_ts) ORDER BY date ASC
